M5 source CAS and durable metadata repair; Root 0541310d-1e6a-4b9f-b0e1-7d5e51538779; git 7def733c00d9c7aeab8058d654e582f176066708

actual.name: e2e_generations_v1
actual.sql:
CREATE TABLE e2e_generations_v1 (
  generation_id text primary key not null,
  article_id text not null,
  generation_seq integer not null check (typeof(generation_seq)='integer' and generation_seq>0),
  source_key text not null,
  source_content_hash text not null,
  approval_key text not null,
  approval_snapshot_hash text not null,
  approval_hash_schema text not null,
  projection_input_hash text not null,
  projection_input_schema text not null,
  expected_version_id text not null,
  expected_version_revision integer not null,
  expected_publication_id text not null,
  expected_publication_revision integer not null,
  expected_publication_state text not null check (expected_publication_state in ('draft','in_review','published','withdrawn')),
  approval_mode text not null check (approval_mode in ('human','automatic')),
  policy_version text not null,
  approval_evidence_ref text not null,
  source_evidence_ref text not null,
  pipeline_run_id text,
  discovery_candidate_id text,
  created_at text not null,
  unique (article_id,generation_seq),
  unique (article_id,generation_id)
)

actual.name: e2e_generation_heads_v1
actual.sql:
CREATE TABLE e2e_generation_heads_v1 (
  article_id text primary key not null,
  generation_id text not null,
  generation_seq integer not null,
  updated_at text not null,
  foreign key (article_id,generation_id) references e2e_generations_v1(article_id,generation_id)
)

actual.name: e2e_generation_progress_v1
actual.sql:
CREATE TABLE e2e_generation_progress_v1 (
  generation_id text primary key not null references e2e_generations_v1(generation_id),
  state text not null check (state in ('processing','publication_committed','search_pending','retry_wait','review_required','blocked','completed_verified','dead_letter','superseded')),
  last_error_code text,
  expected_search_fingerprint text,
  expected_fts_fingerprint text,
  verified_at text,
  verification_evidence_ref text,
  updated_at text not null,
  check (state<>'completed_verified' or (verified_at is not null and verification_evidence_ref is not null))
)

actual.name: e2e_generation_requests_v1
actual.sql:
CREATE TABLE e2e_generation_requests_v1 (
  article_id text not null,
  idempotency_key text not null,
  generation_id text not null references e2e_generations_v1(generation_id),
  context_hash text not null,
  context_document text not null,
  generation_created integer not null check (generation_created in (0,1)),
  primary key (article_id,idempotency_key)
)

actual.name: e2e_commit_guards_v1

CREATE TABLE e2e_commit_guards_v1 (

actual.name: e2e_search_repair_outbox_v1
actual.sql:
CREATE TABLE e2e_search_repair_outbox_v1 (
  outbox_id text primary key not null,
  article_id text not null,
  generation_id text not null,
  generation_seq integer not null check (generation_seq>0),
  operation text not null check (operation in ('project','remove')),
  expected_version_id text not null,
  expected_version_revision integer not null,
  expected_publication_id text not null,
  expected_publication_revision integer not null,
  expected_publication_state text not null,
  policy_version text not null,
  projection_input_hash text not null,
  payload_evidence_ref text not null,
  status text not null default 'pending' check (status in ('pending','leased','retry_wait','verified','superseded','dead_letter')),
  attempt_count integer not null default 0 check (attempt_count>=0),
  max_attempts integer not null default 8,
  next_attempt_at text not null,
  first_failure_at text,
  claimed_by text,
  lease_expires_at text,
  fencing_token integer not null default 0,
  -- Dispatch has its own lease/fence and budget. Duplicate Queue delivery must
  -- not consume the processing attempt budget owned by the M3 Consumer.
  dispatch_owner text,
  dispatch_token text,
  dispatch_lease_expires_at text,
  dispatch_fence integer not null default 0,
  dispatch_count integer not null default 0,
  dispatch_failure_count integer not null default 0,
  first_dispatch_failure_at text,
  next_dispatch_at text not null,
  dispatched_at text,
  last_dispatch_error_code text,
  last_error_code text,
  verified_at text,
  evidence_ref text,
  created_at text not null,
  updated_at text not null,
  unique (article_id,generation_id,operation),
  foreign key (article_id,generation_id) references e2e_generations_v1(article_id,generation_id),
  check (status<>'verified' or (verified_at is not null and evidence_ref is not null))
)

actual.name: e2e_search_repair_dispatch_idx
actual.sql:
CREATE INDEX e2e_search_repair_dispatch_idx
  on e2e_search_repair_outbox_v1 (status,next_dispatch_at,created_at,outbox_id)
